idx_agents_container_id.name: idx_agents_container_id
idx_agents_container_id.where: container_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'destroyed'

channel_members_exactly_one_subject.name: channel_members_exactly_one_subject
channel_members_exactly_one_subject.value: ("channel_members"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("channel_members"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

egress_rules_scope_target.name: egress_rules_scope_target
egress_rules_scope_target.value:
(
        ("egress_rules"."scope" = 'workspace' AND "egress_rules"."blueprint_id" IS NULL AND "egress_rules"."agent_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("egress_rules"."scope" = 'blueprint' AND "egress_rules"."blueprint_id" IS NOT NULL AND "egress_rules"."agent_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("egress_rules"."scope" = 'agent' AND "egress_rules"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "egress_rules"."blueprint_id" IS NULL)
      )
